title: TESS SPOC selection manifest, version 1
description: A reviewed list of light-curve files in subdirectories of raw/<dataset_id>/ that tess-spoc-index indexes. The index method reads each manifest of this format in datasets/<dataset_id>/. It indexes only the listed files. It does not scan subdirectories. A file whose size or SHA-256 differs from its entry is a finding and is not indexed. A file whose content an observation already has is not indexed again.

owner.description: The producer that acquired the files, for example a research agent ID. The files stay in its directory.

registration.description: The ID of the cohort register entry (experiments/cohorts.json) that registers these observations.

relative_path.description: Path below raw/<dataset_id>/, in a subdirectory.

source_id.description: The archive identifier of the file, for example mast:TESS/product/<file name>.
